name: barium sulfate
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE For use in single contrast radiography of the esophagus, pharynx, hypopharynx and for cardiac series.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS This product should not be used in patients with known gastric or intestinal perforation or hypersensitivity to barium sulfate products.
interactions: Drug Interactions The presence of barium sulfate formulations in the GI tract may alter the absorption of therapeutic agents taken concomitantly. In order to minimize any potential change in absorption, the separate administration of barium sulfate from that of other agents should be considered.
